title: Welton — William Farr School, 44 Squadron Book of Remembrance
memorial_type: Metal board on posts + Book of Remembrance
memorial_address: William Farr School, Lincoln Road, Welton, West Lindsey, Lincolnshire LN2 3JB
crew_summary: 498 aircrew killed flying with 44 (Rhodesia) Squadron from RAF Dunholme Lodge, May 1943–September 1944
narrative: RAF Dunholme Lodge, just north of Lincoln, was home to 44 (Rhodesia) Squadron from May 1943 to September 1944, during which 498 of its aircrew were killed. The squadron also shared the airfield with 49, 170, and 619 Squadrons at various times. William Farr School at Welton, the village closest to the former airfield site, became the home of a memorial that honours all four squadrons. A metal board mounted on two posts carries the squadron badges of 44, 49, 170, and 619 Squadrons. Inside the school, the centrepiece is a Book of Remembrance recording every one of the 44 Squadron aircrew killed flying from Dunholme Lodge — 498 names of men who did not return. The school's adoption of this heritage keeps the memory of the squadrons alive for successive generations of students. Access may be restricted during school hours.
memorial_details: Metal board mounted on two posts with badges of 44 Squadron, 49 Squadron, 170 Squadron, and 619 Squadron. Book of Remembrance inside school records every 44 Squadron aircrew killed flying from RAF Dunholme Lodge (May 1943–September 1944). Located at William Farr School, Lincoln Road, Welton, LN2 3JB. Access may be restricted during school hours. IWM War Memorials Register reference: IWM 43137.
